name: TubeHaus

description: TubeHaus for iPad and iPhone: no Google account, recommendations kept on the device. Open source (AGPL-3.0).

apps.name: TubeHaus
apps.subtitle: A private YouTube client
apps.localizedDescription:
TubeHaus is a YouTube client that needs no Google account and keeps what you watch on your device.

- Apple's player, background play and picture-in-picture
- Subscriptions without an account
- Recommendations worked out on the device; tell it to forget a video or a channel
- Import subscriptions from Google Takeout (CSV), NewPipe, FreeTube or Invidious
- Calm mode and Focus: hide Shorts, comments, related videos or thumbnails
- Optional: connect to your own self-hosted TubeHaus server

Beta. Not affiliated with YouTube or Google.

versions.localizedDescription: Shared with the 0.5.16 release: YouTube's topic pages (Music, Live, News, Sports and more), SponsorBlock with Jump to the highlight, dislike counts, DeArrow titles and thumbnails, the "Most replayed" wave, and channel pictures on every card.

Shared with the 0.5.15 release: YouTube-like channel pages, chapters, seek bar previews, search filters, comment sorts, loop, sleep timer and stats for nerds, what's new in the app, and better subscription groups.
Shared with the 0.5.13 release: when the player refuses a video's streams (for example after switching Wi-Fi, mobile data or a VPN), the app fetches fresh ones once and carries on where it stopped.
Shared with the 0.5.11 release: the original audio track is chosen first, plus caption and player sheet updates.
Same version as the Android fix release; no changes on iPad and iPhone.
The channel picture on the watch page shows again when YouTube leaves it out.
iPad: details and comments under the video like YouTube on a computer, up next beside it. Videos play through the connected TubeHaus server when one is connected.
